Game Overview

In The Office Escape, the core idea is straightforward: experience the thrill of escaping a high-stakes office environment. Navigate a maze of surprises, dodge treacherous traps, and solve complex puzzles to outsmart foes. With quick reflexes and sharp decision-making, break free from mundane confines and triumph in your mission to escape the Regime's clutches.
